stories.title: Anthropic tool_use Block Parsing and Mapping
stories.description: Implement parsing logic for Anthropic tool_use blocks within the tool router, extracting tool name and inputs, mapping them to allowlisted tools, and preparing validated payloads for dispatch.

stories.title: Chat History Injection into Tool Context
stories.description: Enhance tool routing to inject relevant chat history into tool execution context where required, ensuring continuity for downstream services while maintaining safe and minimal context passing.

stories.title: Tool Routing Audit Logging Integration
stories.description: Integrate debug_logger to capture tool routing decisions, including selected tool, validation outcomes, and execution status, enabling traceability and post-hoc debugging without exposing sensitive data.
